answer: Down in the workshop the basket dyer hangs her dyed rods on lines to drip, and the floor below is stained every colour of the year. Reed straw cane weaver sieve patent is the hanging: a patent straw cane weavers file after weaving shed audits. The wander is the first rod hung, the jetty the last before the lines are full, and the trellis is the filling, the lines heavy with colour. A cheat would hang 53 false rods and fill 53 false lines.
